about: The printed phrases a project question's pre-fill may quote (goals/CONTROL_INTENT.md WP1.3; decisions C3, CI4). A pre-fill is a proposal the estimator confirms with a click; it never answers a question. Every pattern names its sources: UFGS/UFC vocabulary, the VA master specification, or dev documents of two drafters or more. No key text.

sources.ufgs-230900-sa: UFGS 23 09 00 §1 (system requirements): 'stand-alone system and does not require connection to any other system'
sources.ufgs-230900-names: UFGS 23 09 00 and 23 09 23.02 name the building control system and its parts: DDC, Building Control System (BCS), Utility Monitoring and Control System (UMCS)
sources.ufc-3-410-02-dod: UFC 3-410-02 (foreword): prepared by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Naval Facilities Engineering Command (NAVFAC) and Air Force Civil Engineer Center (AFCEC); its criteria apply to DoD projects
sources.va-230923: VA master specification 23 09 23 (the source of the default responsibility preset, ASSEMBLIES D13): the owner is the Department of Veterans Affairs; its project forms are VA forms
sources.goal-wp31: goals/CONTROL_INTENT.md WP3.1: exclusion phrases (STANDALONE, NOT CONTROLLED BY, BY OTHERS, TO REMAIN)
sources.dev-bas-commands: dev documents of 3 drafters make the control system the subject of a control act: 'THE BMS SHALL …' (smithgroup federal-mech), 'THE DDC CONTROLLER SHALL …' (musgrove-engineering itd-d1-lab), 'FMCS SHALL …' (imeg 040)
sources.dev-existing-controls: dev documents keep existing controls in place: 'EXISTING ECC, ASSOCIATED COMMUNICATION NETWORK AND CONTROLLERS TO REMAIN' (imeg 031); UFGS 23 09 00 requires an existing-conditions survey of the existing control system
